signature.name: Ampel Mosque
signature.detail: Surabaya's most famous landmark and the heart of the old Arab quarter, a pilgrimage site tied to the spread of Islam in Java. Visit outside prayer times and dress modestly; the surrounding Ampel market is lively in the morning.

signature.name: House of Sampoerna
signature.detail: A beautifully preserved colonial-era cigarette factory and museum that tells the story of one of Indonesia's best-known companies. It is a must-see for its architecture and free guided tours; go in the morning to watch the hand-rolling floor at work.

signature.name: Suramadu Bridge
signature.detail: Indonesia's long bridge linking Surabaya to Madura and one of the city's defining modern sights. Drive or take a taxi across for views, ideally in the late afternoon or at sunset.

signature.name: Surabaya Zoo
signature.detail: A large, long-established city zoo and a familiar family outing in Surabaya. Go early in the day when it is cooler and animals are more active.

signature.name: Cheng Hoo Mosque
signature.detail: A distinctive mosque blending Chinese and Islamic architecture, honoring the admiral Cheng Hoo. It is a short stop worth combining with a visit to the old town; dress modestly.

transport: Taxis and ride-hailing cheap; short trips $2-5
